title: Acquire relation spaces of formal monomial supports after cancellation
statement: For a raw characteristic-two circuit P, H_S=sum_(R subset S) P(z with R zeroed) retains exactly formal monomials containing S. Shared zeroed evaluations and field-coordinate span learning acquire all degree-D identities on supports of nonzero monomials after cancellation. The computed conservative formal degree Delta supplies the Delta/q miss bound. No expansion or multilinearity promise is required. This relation-space operation does not acquire arbitrary Boolean satisfying assignments or a general feasible-witness decoder.

requires: Squarefree Boolean features over F2, their actual feasible-point span and its orthogonal identity space.
For graph N=2n, fingerprint field q>n and independent probes with (L_D+1)(n/q)^t <= delta.
For arithmetic circuits, supports are taken after polynomial cancellation; use the conservative syntactic formal degree Delta and q>Delta.
Conditioning and adaptive query DAGs pay the total query-degree budget and actual intermediate widths.

assumptions: P3 contributes only its normally visible scientific response. No code or source package was uploaded, exported, repackaged or acquired through another route. Probabilistic acquisition and m^O(D) costs remain explicit. Witness knowledge is not counting or a positive probability mixture; no practical speedup, new independent audit or historical priority is established.
costs: Graph probes cost O(L_D N^3) field operations safely, or O(N^3+L_D D^3) when nonsingular, with an exact direct-minor fallback. At most (L_D+1)t probes; elimination, bit costs, feature construction and storage are additional.

Eager acquisition adds at most R_D witness decodings, each using O(m) filtered evaluations. The prototype GF(256) restrictions n<256 and Delta<256 are implementation limits; the general theorem chooses a larger field.
A conventional demand-driven algebraic teacher makes at most L_D expensive updates on the all-correct event. The counting consumer adds Pfaffian work and up to 2^rho signed terms.

The bounded K8 search of 2048 candidates failed to find rank two; it is not a certificate of impossibility. Reported K6 counting was 116 us versus memoized 21 us; K4,4 was 168 us versus memoized 48 us and Ryser 11 us. Acquisition and search are extra.
